items.label: Victory Giant Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-28-2026)
items.signal_prefix: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 11,629,367,290.81, up 28.77%

set.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 11,629,367,290.81, up 28.77% year over year; cost of sales RMB 7,765,934,717.93, up 34.83% on higher product costs; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,856,778,938.24, up 33.30%; excluding non-recurring items RMB 2,417,800,485.07, up 12.50%. Non-recurring items totalled RMB 438,978,453.17, including RMB 587,855,102.17 of fair-value changes and disposal gains on financial assets; the report attributes the period's RMB 594,820,131.07 fair-value gain mainly to placement shares held. Operating cash flow RMB 2,911,175,283.00, up 144.61% on higher sales collections. Inventory rose to RMB 5,889,639,980.56 from RMB 3,162,360,350.96 at end-2025 (raw materials RMB 2,501,790,222.00).

items.reason: The non-recurring fair-value line is RMB 587,855,102.17; RMB 594,820,131.07 is the total fair-value P&L from another table, and the report does not say non-recurring items were mainly that gain.
items.evidence: p8 non-recurring items: fair-value changes and disposal gains on financial assets 587,855,102.17; total 438,978,453.17. p20: fair-value gain 594,820,131.07, mainly placement shares held
